prompt: Create a vertical 9:16 photorealistic glamour weather-broadcast studio image. A young Japanese female weather presenter, Sayaka, stands full-body on the left side, smiling gently at the camera, with short silver-gray bob hair, natural makeup, slim build, and white high heels. She wears a bright coral orange sleeveless cropped vest with matching high-waisted mini skirt, plus a teal scarf tied at the neck and a small black lavalier microphone on her chest. Her right hand holds a thin silver pointer angled toward the weather map behind her; her left arm rests naturally by her side. The studio is glossy and luxurious, with warm golden bokeh lights, reflective gold floor, soft spotlights, and a curved modern TV set. On the right side, place a large curved digital screen showing a blue ocean map of Japan with green land and sunny weather markers. At the top of the screen, display the headline “Sayaka’s ChatGPT weather report” in playful green lettering with a small flower icon at the far right. On the map, include Japanese text for the date and title: 今日の天気 4月30日(水). Include exactly 9 visible sunny forecast cards, each a small white rounded rectangle with an orange sun icon and city/temperature label: Sapporo 13°C, Niigata 17°C, Sendai 18°C, Tokyo 23°C, Nagoya 22°C, Osaka 21°C, Hiroshima 20°C, Fukuoka 20°C, and Naha 27°C. Use realistic photography, high detail skin and fabric texture, shallow depth of field, studio lighting, clean composition, no watermark, no extra people, no additional forecast cards, and keep all visible text legible.

promptZh: 创建一个 9:16 的竖屏照片级真实感华丽天气预报演播室图像。一位年轻的日本女性天气预报员，Sayaka，全身像站在左侧，对着镜头温柔微笑，留着银灰色短波波头，妆容自然，身材苗条，穿着白色高跟鞋。她穿着一件明亮的 珊瑚橙色 无袖短款背心，搭配同色系高腰短裙，颈部系着一条青色丝巾，胸前佩戴着一个小型黑色领夹式麦克风。她的右手拿着一根细长的银色指示棒，指向身后的天气地图；左臂自然垂在身侧。演播室光亮奢华，带有温暖的金色光斑、反光的金色地板、柔和的聚光灯以及现代化的弧形电视装置。在右侧，放置一个大型弧形数字屏幕，显示着日本的蓝色海洋地图，地图上有绿色的陆地和晴天天气图标。在屏幕顶部，显示标题“Sayaka’s ChatGPT weather report”，采用俏皮的绿色字体，最右侧带有一个小花图标。在地图上，包含日期和标题的日语文本：今日の天気 4月30日(水)。包含确切 9 张可见的晴天预报卡片，每张都是带有橙色太阳图标和城市/温度标签的小型白色圆角矩形：札幌 13°C、新潟 17°C、仙台 18°C、东京 23°C、名古屋 22°C、大阪 21°C、广岛 20°C、福冈 20°C 和那霸 27°C。使用写实摄影风格，高细节的皮肤和织物纹理，浅景深，演播室灯光，构图简洁，无水印，无其他人物，无额外的预报卡片，并确保所有可见文字清晰可辨。
